description: The verify step cannot detect a low-quality or garbled-but-correctly-sized slide. compose_slides.py:58 draws text starting at fixed top=150 with no bounding/clipping check; a slide whose text has many or long lines overflows past y=1920 (off-canvas) yet the saved PNG is still exactly 1080x1920 and PASSES producer.sh:43. Likewise the gradient-only background (producer.sh:20-32) with text confined to the top region (compose draws from top=150, CTA #PR at H-110) means the middle/lower ~3/4 of every slide is empty gradient — a viable-but-thin slideshow that the geometry-only gate rates as fully verified. Could queue overflowed/illegible slides. No pixel-content, text-bbox-within-canvas, or contrast assertion exists.

evidence.snippet: y = top ... y += int(line_h * lh)  # no check that y stays < H; end_y = draw_text(d, lines, font, top=150, color=INK)
